notes: Bounds are conservative operational review rules, not fitted quantiles or physical laws. Values outside bounds become null only in cleaned data and remain in raw data.
Weak contact is an explicitly provisional exit-speed proxy below 75 mph, not an official weak-contact definition.
PitchCall is the provisional event source. Strong cross-field contradictions make model labels null until adjudication.
Pitcher and game IDs are grouping keys, never default predictive features.
Chronology is available only at season level; row order does not imply chronology.
